learned_rules.request: Build a cinematic luxury landing page for Nocturne Audio, a premium spatial-audio headphone brand. It should feel immersive, tactile, nocturnal, editorial, and product-led. The first viewport should not be a generic split SaaS hero. Prefer a full-bleed product/media hero or immersive scene with the headphone as the first-viewport signal, with refined launch copy, product close-up moments, soundstage proof, creator testimonials, and a conversion path for preorders. Use rich dark materials, controlled contrast, precise typography, and subtle motion direction; avoid generic dashboard cards, operations copy, backend/Web3 language, and bland business-consulting phrasing.

output_contract.minimum_depth: 5 meaningful sections for a landing/website page

taxonomy_prompt_profile.decision_moment: A high-intent private client is deciding whether the brand feels rare, crafted, and worthy of a personal inquiry.
taxonomy_prompt_profile.design_answer: Use restraint, material detail, provenance, appointment paths, and quiet confidence instead of badges or discounts.
headline_directions: Crafted for private clients who notice the difference.
A quieter standard of luxury, made visible.
taxonomy_prompt_profile.layout_signature: immersive hero, provenance story, product/editorial modules, appointment or concierge path
taxonomy_prompt_profile.message: The brand is scarce, crafted, and worth slowing down for.
taxonomy_prompt_profile.primary_objection: The experience can feel mass-market, loud, or insufficiently premium.
sections: Create desire with brand, material detail, and a discreet action.
Show why the object/service is rare and credible.
Let the visitor inspect options without ecommerce clutter.
Make the next step private and high-touch.
taxonomy_prompt_profile.visual_language: large negative space, close-up materials, elegant asymmetry, slow reveal

user_intent.raw_request: Build a cinematic luxury landing page for Nocturne Audio, a premium spatial-audio headphone brand. It should feel immersive, tactile, nocturnal, editorial, and product-led. The first viewport should not be a generic split SaaS hero. Prefer a full-bleed product/media hero or immersive scene with the headphone as the first-viewport signal, with refined launch copy, product close-up moments, soundstage proof, creator testimonials, and a conversion path for preorders. Use rich dark materials, controlled contrast, precise typography, and subtle motion direction; avoid generic dashboard cards, operations copy, backend/Web3 language, and bland business-consulting phrasing.

variant_briefs.direction: Editorial luxury lookbook with immersive imagery, provenance, and discreet concierge action.
variant_briefs.evaluation_focus: Will this be credible, usable, distinctive, and implementable in production?
variant_briefs.must_change: Use or reinterpret the Full-Bleed Media Hero composition archetype with the Interactive 3D experience mode. Change first-viewport structure, motion/interaction strategy, proof object placement, and section emphasis. Do not only change colors.
